mapper.sql: select a.id, a.phone, a.api_id, a.api_hash, a.tg_user_id, a.nickname, a.username, a.country, a.device_model, a.system_version, a.app_version, a.lang_code, a.system_lang_code, a.batch_no, a.group_id, a.status, a.proxy_ip_id, a.proxy_group_no, a.proxy_url, a.proxy_protocol, a.proxy_host, a.proxy_port, a.proxy_username, a.proxy_password, a.auto_reply, a.is_restricted, a.is_frozen, a.total_msg_count, a.sent_msg_count, a.recv_msg_count, a.node_id, a.json_content, a.last_login_time, a.create_time, a.update_time, b.title as batchTitle, pg.group_name as proxyGroupTitle, ag.group_name as groupName from tg_telethon_account a left join tg_import_batch b on a.batch_no = b.batch_no left join tg_proxy_group pg on a.proxy_group_no = pg.group_no left join tg_account_group ag on a.group_id = ag.id
mapper.select: select * from tg_telethon_account where (node_id IS NULL OR node_id = '') AND (is_deleted = 0 OR is_deleted IS NULL) order by id
mapper.update: update tg_telethon_account set node_id = #{nodeId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update tg_telethon_account set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}

update tg_telethon_account set is_deleted = 1, status = 'offline', update_time = now() where id in
#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tg_telethon_account (phone, batch_no, status, is_deleted, node_id, json_content, session_content, create_time) VALUES (#{phone}, #{batchNo}, 'waiting', 0, #{nodeId}, #{jsonContent}, #{sessionContent}, now()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE batch_no = #{batchNo}, status = 'waiting', is_deleted = 0, node_id = #{nodeId}, json_content = #{jsonContent}, session_content = #{sessionContent}, update_time = now()
mapper.update: update tg_telethon_account set proxy_ip_id = #{proxyIpId}, proxy_group_no = #{proxyGroupNo}, proxy_url = #{proxyUrl}, proxy_protocol = #{proxyProtocol}, proxy_host = #{proxyHost}, proxy_port = #{proxyPort}, proxy_username = #{proxyUsername}, proxy_password = #{proxyPassword}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update tg_telethon_account set auto_reply = #{autoReply}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update tg_telethon_account set is_restricted = 0, update_time = now() where is_restricted = 1 AND (is_frozen = 0 OR is_frozen IS NULL)

update tg_telethon_account set group_id = #{groupId}, update_time = now() where id in

mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS id, IFNULL(stats.total_count, 0) AS totalMsgCount, IFNULL(stats.sent_count, 0) AS sentMsgCount, IFNULL(stats.recv_count, 0) AS recvMsgCount FROM tg_telethon_account a INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT c.tg_account_id FROM tg_contact c WHERE c.last_send_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) OR c.last_receive_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) ) act ON a.id = act.tg_account_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m.tg_account_id, COUNT(*) as total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.is_outgoing = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sent_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.is_outgoing = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as recv_count FROM tg_chat_message m LEFT JOIN tg_contact bc ON bc.tg_account_id = m.tg_account_id AND bc.user_id = m.chat_id WHERE m.chat_id >= 0 AND m.chat_id NOT IN (777000) AND (bc.is_bot IS NULL OR bc.is_bot = 0) AND m.tg_account_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT c.tg_account_id FROM tg_contact c WHERE c.last_send_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) OR c.last_receive_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) ) GROUP BY m.tg_account_id ) stats ON a.id = stats.tg_account_id
select phone from tg_telethon_account where phone is not null and phone <> ''
